verses.text: Ix in tanhwejnhej skolwal Jehová, haxo ix ab'ani ayik ix in tewi t'ay.
Ix in yik'k'eta t'a jun olan te ay smay. Ix in skol b'aj sitz'atak. Ix in yak'ank'e t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en k'e'en yik tzin tek'b'ej in b'a.
Ix yak' wal jun b'it ak'to t'ayin, b'it yik aloj wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal. Komonok sat sk'ol jantak heb' tz'ilan jun tik, yik syak'och Jehová heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'o'ol, max yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, haton heb' tz'och tzak'an t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios.

Mamin Jehová in Diosal, manh jantakok juntzanh tas satub'tak ix a b'o'o yet' jantak a wach'k'olal ix ak' t'ayonh. Malaj junok mach syal slajb'an sb'a het'ok. In gana swalel masanil a wach'k'olal chi', palta max in tzak'wanlaj, yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
Max a nib'ejlaj nok' nok' yet' ixim trigo silab'il. Malaj nok' nok' tza k'ana' yik snhusji silab'il t'ayach, ma silab' yik stupkanel ko mul. Palta ix a jak in chikin yik tzin cha wab' tas tzala'.
Yuj chi' ix wala': Tik tzin ja'i, xin chi. Ha tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a a lolonel, a wab'ixal syala'.
Ach in Diosal, snib'ej in k'o'ol tzin k'ulej icha a gana. Ayoch a k'ayb'ub'al t'a in pensar.
Mamin Jehová, ix walkanel yab'ixal a tojolal t'a skal heb' a chonhab'. Ojtak wal to malaj b'aj ix waktejkan walaneli.

Malaj b'aj max walel a tojolal. Ix walel yab'ixal to tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala', tzak'anpax kolnab'il. Malaj b'aj ix in k'ub'ejel t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab' molanek'i, to te niwan a wach'k'olal, yelnhej pax tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, ayokab'nhej ok'elk'olal t'ayin. Ilinnhej yet' a wach'k'olal icha ix aj halani.

Yujto te ay tas sjawi t'a wib'anh, maxtzak b'ischajlaj wu'uj. In yamchajelta yuj in chukal. Ichato maxtzak yal-laj wilani. Ek'b'al in chukal chi' t'a yichanh sb'isul xil in jolom. Wanxo somchajel in k'o'ol.
Mamin, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, kotanh, kolineli. Kotanh elanhchamel, tzach och wet'ok.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, jawokab' k'ixwelal yet' somk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. B'atokab' heb' elelal t'a skal niwak k'ixwelal, yujto snib'ej heb' yak'an chukal t'ayin.
Ha heb' tzin b'uchani, kanokab' heb' t'a manh pensaril yuj somk'olal.
Haxo masanil heb' ayoch spensar t'ayach, tzalajokab' heb' t'ayach. Te niwan elk'och ach Jehová, xchiokab' heb' snib'an a kolwal.
Ha inxo jun, ob'iltak in, ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Mamin, mokab' in b'atkan satk'olal u'uj. Ha ach tzach ochtaxon wet'ok yik tzin a kolani. Ach Jehová in Diosal, manh ik'ek' tiempo in a kolani.
